label: late-episode gain on S2-last-trial / no-reward D1 and a1 choice at D2
terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_state == S2) * np.exp(ep_trial/15) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == S1) * np.exp(ep_trial/15) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == S1) * np.exp(ep_trial/15) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 0) * np.exp(ep_trial/15) ;; (phase == GO) * np.exp(ep_trial/15) * (prev_reward==1) ;; (prev_action == 1) * np.exp(ep_trial/15) ;; (tv("action", -2) == 1) * np.exp(ep_trial/15) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * np.exp(ep_trial/15)
explanation: Raw update gate z of unit 33 is small (mean 0.037) and grows roughly exponentially over the episode (timing alone R^2 0.69, D2 > D1 > GO). History effects are multiplicative: they scale with the same late-episode growth, so every term is an indicator times exp(ep_trial/15). Additive unscaled indicators reached only about 0.09 on dev, and the scaled ones reach about 0.40, above the additive all-cue ceiling of 0.30. Fitted pattern: at D1 the gate is higher when the previous trial reached S2 and lower when it reached S1, plus a further rise when the previous trial was unrewarded (so after a1 S2 u it is highest and after a2 S1 r lowest). At GO it rises a little after a rewarded trial. At D2 it is raised strongly when this trial chose a1, slightly offset when S1 was reached. Choosing a1 two trials back adds a small amount at every phase. All terms are observed at their step; no future or hidden variables are used. Remaining error: some episodes run uniformly lower or higher than predicted during long a1/S1 runs late in the episode (activation builds up across consecutive a1 S1 rewarded trials), which these terms capture only partly. Adding the policy logit did not help.
